name: AgiBot World 2026: Real-World Embodied Intelligence Dataset
description: AgiBot World 2026 is a large-scale real-world robotic demonstration dataset designed to advance embodied AI from laboratory settings into unconstrained commercial spaces, supermarkets, and domestic homes. Collected on the AGIBOT G2 dual-arm mobile platform, the dataset provides structured, multi-layer hierarchical annotations following the LeRobot v2.1 standard. It contains full-horizon restocking and shelf-organization demonstrations annotated across three complementary layers: subtask task frames, 2D interaction bounding boxes, and step-level primitive skill segments. The physical dataset is paired with 1:1 digital twin simulation environments released in the GenieSim project.

verification.notes: Verified against agibot-world.com and Hugging Face repository agibot-world/AgiBotWorld2026. Documented LeRobot v2.1 structure, AGIBOT G2 dual-arm platform, GenieSim digital twin pairing, and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. The collection spans thousands of episodes across hundreds of commercial task archives; individual Parquet rows represent sensor/action frames rather than discrete episodes, so aggregate episode totals are set to unknown status rather than conflated with row counts.

size.notes: Structured in LeRobot v2.1 format with per-episode Apache Parquet data files, multi-camera MP4 videos (top_head, hand_left, hand_right), and JSONL metadata. Individual tasks are packaged as 5-10 GB archives with a 7 GB standalone sample.

citation.paper_title: AgiBot World 2026: Real-World Embodied Intelligence Dataset

provenance.collection_method: Free-form physical teleoperation on the AGIBOT G2 dual-arm mobile platform across authentic retail and commercial environments, with concurrent 1:1 simulation recording in GenieSim.
provenance.curation_notes: Distinguishes from earlier AgiBot Alpha/Beta test collections by introducing full-length commercial retail tasks formatted to LeRobot v2.1 with comprehensive 3-tier annotations.
data_sources: Original commercial and retail physical deployments by AgiBot
